fable_reason: Continuous autonomous loop pattern; generic orchestration but niche and risky.

problem_solved: Implements the 'Ralph Wiggum' technique: a Stop-hook while-true loop that refeeds the identical prompt every iteration until a max-iteration cap or a truthful 'completion promise' string is emitted.
rationale: Cleanly engineered (stop-hook + setup script + cancel command + anti-false-promise rule) but blind same-prompt iteration conflicts with this harness's checkpointed, beads-anchored execution (run-phases) and AK rule 10; only the completion-promise guard is a durable idea, too small to justify adoption.
overlap_with_existing: run-phases skill (state-driven sequential phase loop), host loop skill (interval re-run); both supersede blind reiteration.
evidence_notes: Read plugins/ralph-loop/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and commands/ralph-loop.md (completion-promise CRITICAL RULE); listed dir (stop-hook.sh, setup-ralph-loop.sh, cancel-ralph.md).
